projects.title: AI-Based Autonomous Crop Disease Detection and Control Drone
projects.description: An autonomous drone system that uses AI to detect crop disease at an early stage and responds by autonomously spraying pesticide to control the spread, aimed at improving crop yield and reducing manual field monitoring.

projects.title: Smoke Detection System
projects.description: A control system that detects smoke within a home and raises an alarm to alert occupants early, reducing response time in the event of a fire hazard.
